Don't move the page while I'm reading Continuity

Finding

Sometimes new content loads into a page and pushes the existing content down.

I'm reading something and suddenly the page moves because an image, ad, or other content loaded above it.

Now I have to find where I was again.

Idea

When new content loads, keep the user's current position stable.

For example, if I'm reading the 5th paragraph and an image loads above it, the page should adjust so that I'm still looking at the 5th paragraph.

The line you were reading, four paragraphs down.
reading here
image loads above · +176 px scroll corrected · +176 px the line you were reading · 0 px
Watching Runs on its own

Why I like it

The user may never know why the page feels better.

They just don't lose their place.

When the interface changes, don't make the user lose their place.
